At any speciﬁc time, you only pay for the number of Ingestion OCUs that are allocated to a
pipeline, regardless of whether there's data ﬂowing through the pipeline. OpenSearch Ingestion
immediately accommodates your workloads by scaling pipeline capacity up or down based on
usage.
For full pricing details, see Amazon OpenSearch Service pricing.
